subject: Request: Inference ops capacity + routing playbook — technical session
messages:
From: Sara Voss <sara@currantlabs.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel@currantlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: technical session on capacity & routing playbook

Hi Grace / Vivek —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today. We were able to confirm Currant's peak traffic profile and the multi-tenant constraints we mentioned on the call. Daniel and I would like to book a technical session to go deeper on two items before procurement:

- A concrete capacity plan (throughput targets, burst windows) and how Redwood maps those to Dedicated vs Hosted options
- Smart routing/fallback playbook — how requests get routed across model variants/regions when latency SLOs are at risk

We'd like the session to be hands-on and include a short review of our discovery notes (I'll attach the draft). Do you have 60–75 minutes this week or early next week? Our preferences: Wed 9/3 10:00–11:15am PT or Thu 9/4 2:00–3:15pm PT.

Also please confirm whether we should share any additional artifacts (traffic traces, example prompt distributions) ahead of time.

Thanks — looking forward.

Sara Voss
Head of Platform Engineering
Currant Labs

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (5 pages)
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Voss <sara@currantlabs.com>, Daniel Park <daniel@currantlabs.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical session on capacity & routing playbook

Sara —

Thanks for the note and the discovery draft, that was helpful. Looping in Karthik from Solutions Engineering so we can scope a practical agenda and come ready with config examples (batching, KV cache hints, routing policies).

We can do a 75-minute working session. Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 9/3 10:00–11:15 (your first choice)
- Thu 9/4 2:00–3:15
- Mon 9/8 9:00–10:15 (backup)

Agenda we suggest:
1) Quick recap (10m) — goals & success criteria
2) Capacity plan walk-through (20m) — throughput numbers, expected p50/p95 latencies, burst model
3) Routing & fallback playbook (20m) — model variants, region failover, cost-vs-latency policies
4) Hands-on run-through (20m) — config snippets, example request flows, sample metrics to monitor
5) Action items & next steps (5m)

Pre-reads that would help Karthik prepare:
- raw token-level traffic distribution (CSV)
- example prompts and average sequence lengths
- any compliance/retention constraints that affect private deployment options

If you confirm Wed 10am PT we'll send a calendar invite with a short folder of artifacts from our side.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Manager, Pre-Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical session on capacity & routing playbook

Hi all —

Thanks for the details. If we lock Wed 9/3 10:00 PT I'll prepare:
- A candidate capacity plan spreadsheet showing token/sec vs instance sizing (both Hosted and Dedicated)
- Two routing playbook examples: low-cost (better batching, quantization) and low-latency (dedicated pools, route-by-latency)
- A short demo script to exercise failover (region + model-variant fallback) using a small synthetic load

Prep requests from Currant: please share the token distribution CSV and one representative prompt set (5–10 prompts). If you can also send any retention/compliance constraints that might push you toward Private deployment, that would be great.

Also note: for the hands-on demo I'll need an S3 bucket or Drive link to place the synthetic traces and the runbook slide deck (redwood-capacity-playbook-v1.pptx). If you prefer we can host everything on our side and send links after the invite is accepted.

Confirming Wed 9/3 10:00–11:15 PT works for us. I'll create the demo scaffold and share the invite + materials by EOD tomorrow.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments (from our side): currant_slo_requirements.xlsx
From: Sara Voss <sara@currantlabs.com>

Grace / Karthik —

Thanks, Wed 9/3 10:00 PT is perfect. We'll send the token CSV and a 10-prompt sample before EOD today. I'll also upload our compliance note to the Drive folder you linked.

One quick ask for the session: can you include (if possible) a short slide that maps expected cost delta between the two playbooks (per-1M tokens estimate) — procurement will want a ballpark in the meeting.

Looking forward. Please include a dial-in and calendar invite.

Sara Voss
Head of Platform Engineering
Currant Labs
